task.description: Generate an Ascend/CANN C++ source project from the real STRATA routing, activation and aggregation implementation, and independently compile and numerically validate its CPU reference. Source production only; native device execution and full-model inference require separate acceptance.
Build a generated-source STRATA candidate for native Ascend inference and compare with the original CUDA model.
Compose production routing and scalar scaling with independent numeric acceptance for each selected operation.
Construct production normalization from the actual elementwise source module.
Construct the discovered STRATA routing, activation and aggregation source project.
